definitions.positive_parent_family: P_v={C in F : v in C}
definitions.cross_union_width_star: chi*_F(v)=max |R| over NON_TAUTOLOGICAL cross-polarity parent pairs; define chi*_F(v)=0 if every cross pair is tautological

bipolar_exact_dp_lemma.statement: For a bipolar pivot v, if chi*_F(v)<=4, then the canonical exact Davis-Putnam post-formula eliminating v has maximum clause width <=4, contains no fresh variables, removes v, and is an exact existentially equivalent successor with proof-carrying model reconstruction.
proof: Every untouched clause avoids v and -v and already has width <=4.
Every retained exact-DP resolvent is exactly one non-tautological remainder union R.
The hypothesis chi*_F(v)<=4 bounds every retained resolvent by width 4.
Tautological cross-pair resolvents are discarded by exact DP and therefore cannot violate the persisted width bound.
Canonical duplicate collapse and subsumption/minimization cannot increase width.
Exact DP eliminates v and introduces no variables, so variable rank strictly decreases by at least one and no fresh variable appears.
For bipolar v, existing r45a.exact_dp_record plus independent_dp_replay certifies the projected formula and r42.reconstruct_sa_bve reconstructs a predecessor assignment.

pure_polarity_lane.mathematical_fact: If a variable occurs in only one polarity, existential projection can delete all clauses containing its pure literal by assigning that literal true.

hard_complement_class.name: BIPOLAR_NONT_AUTO_CROSS_UNION_WIDTH5_CORE
hard_complement_class.meaning: Only this complement class needs R47J/RUP/SA_BVE width-discharge or a stronger invariant for W4 STEP coverage.

important_nonclaims: This lemma does not prove that every W4 state has an easy pure or chi*-safe bipolar pivot.
This lemma does not prove universal W4 STEP coverage.
This lemma does not prove O4 or SAT_IN_P.
This lemma does not prove P=NP or P!=NP.
